movie.title: Ali G: Who Iz I?
movie.overview: After twenty years spent "chillin', tokin' and bonin'", Ali G is shocked to discover that his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is 8 months pregnant. Faced with an extra mouth to feed, he gets off his batty and heads to America to reclaim his former glory… but soon encounters adversaries who will ultimately threaten his and his child's very existence.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Faced with impending fatherhood after twenty years of slacking, Ali G travels to America to rebuild his career, only to encounter dangerous new foes.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Ali G's relaxed lifestyle comes to an abrupt halt when he learns his long-term girlfriend, Julie, is eight months pregnant. Realizing he must step up to support his growing family, he leaves his comfortable routine behind and journeys to America to reclaim his former fame. However, his quest for success takes a perilous turn as he crosses paths with formidable adversaries. Ultimately, Ali G must outsmart his enemies to protect both his legacy and his unborn child's future.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: After spending two decades focused solely on relaxing, smoking, and enjoying life without major responsibilities, Ali G receives life-altering news. His longtime girlfriend, Julie, reveals that she is eight months pregnant, forcing Ali G to confront the realities of imminent fatherhood. Realizing that his current lifestyle cannot sustain an expanding family, he decides it is time to get off his rear end and take drastic action. He sets off for the United States, aiming to reignite his media career and reclaim the glory days of his youth. Upon arriving in America, Ali G immerses himself in a whirlwind attempt to rebuild his image and make quick money. However, his naive hustle quickly attracts the attention of powerful and dangerous adversaries who view him as a threat. As tensions escalate, Ali G finds himself caught in a high-stakes conflict that goes far beyond simple career ambitions. He must rely on his unique wit, unconventional instincts, and street smarts to navigate the treacherous environment. With the clock ticking toward Julie's due date, Ali G fights to overcome his enemies and ensure a safe, prosperous future for his child.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Ali G: Who Iz I? follows the iconic, track-suit-wearing character as he reaches a critical turning point in his life. Having coasted for twenty years on a diet of leisure and minimal effort, Ali G's comfortable world is upended when his partner, Julie, announces her late-stage pregnancy. Pushed by financial necessity and a sudden wave of parental responsibility, Ali G leaves Staines for America, determined to revive his public persona and secure financial stability. The comedy-drama blends Ali G's signature satirical humor with personal stakes as he navigates unfamiliar American turf, cultural clashes, and unexpected antagonism from shadowy foes.
